articleTitle: AI Co‑Founders: How Gusto, Insight Partners, and Leland Are Reshaping Startup Hiring at Disrupt 2026

claims.claim: The session titled “Hiring When AI Is a Co‑Founder” will take place at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

editorial.claim: Human leaders are still required to interpret ambiguous market signals, negotiate partnerships, and build trust with stakeholders.
The panel suggests that the most valuable human contributions lie in areas where judgment, creativity, and relational intelligence are essential—domains where AI currently lacks depth.
